content:
Deleting a collection deletes all data and indexes in the collection. You can't recover collections
after you delete them.
Managing collections
403
Amazon OpenSearch Service
Developer Guide
To delete a collection using the console
1.
From the Collections panel of the Amazon OpenSearch Service console, select the collection
you want to delete.
2.
Choose Delete and conﬁrm deletion.
To delete a collection using the AWS CLI, send a DeleteCollection request:
aws opensearchserverless delete-collection --id 07tjusf2h91cunochc
Sample response
{
"deleteCollectionDetail":{
"id":"07tjusf2h91cunochc",
"name":"my-collection",
"status":"DELETING"
}
}
